messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Park <emily@talentops.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cohort-based staggered review windows & manager materials

Team —

Draft proposal attached. High level: instead of a single org-wide review window, I propose we run two staggered cohorts (A and B) to reduce manager load, smooth calibration, and allow a smaller pilot to validate scripts and forms. Key asks in this thread:

- Confirm whether we can run a 6-week staggered cadence (Pilot A: Jul 11–Aug 1; Pilot B: Aug 8–Aug 29).
- Review the attached manager script and the updated review form (2027_review_form_v2.docx) for any content/checkbox/privacy gaps.
- Flag any teams with compliance-sensitive roles that require an embargo or privileged handling.

Notes:
- Emily will help with manager training content and will be looped into the pilot retros.
- We should lock in the pilot cohort list by EOD Wed (May 12) so people ops can schedule training slots.

Attachments: 2027_review_form_v2.docx, manager_script_staggered.md, pilot_cohort_list.xlsx

Thanks —
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of People Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Emily Park <emily@talentops.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cohort-based staggered review windows & manager materials

Thanks Grace — quick thoughts after a skim of the materials:

- Timeline: I support staggered cohorts but recommend Pilot A be shorter (3 weeks) to validate rubrics quickly. Long pilots make correction slower.
- Manager script: suggest adding two short callouts for handling sensitive feedback (one-sentence scripts managers can copy) and a short escalation checkbox on the form.
- Overlap: avoid scheduling calibration meetings during the first week of Q3 planning — ops will be light.

I can sync with Mina on the pilot cohort list this afternoon.

On the attachments: 2027_review_form_v2.docx looks good functionally; we should ensure versioning (v2) is clear in the header so managers don't grab older forms.

—Jordan

- Manager checklist includes a mandatory privacy checkbox for any role marked "privileged" in our data-handling registry.
- Suggested blackout: teams with SOC2/private-customer work (infra, security, some solutions) should have a 2-week embargo before notifications to avoid leaking planning details.
- Short escalation flow: manager -> policy lead (Vivek) -> People Ops for rapid remediation.

Thanks for the quick turns. Final decisions below:

1) Pilot windows confirmed
- Cohort A (short pilot): Jul 11–Jul 31 (3 weeks)
- Cohort B (full pilot): Aug 8–Aug 29 (3 weeks active + calibration week as needed)

2) Documents & owners
- Manager script: manager_script_staggered.md — Owner: Emily Park / TalentOps (training content)
- Review form: 2027_review_form_v2.docx — Owner: People Ops (Grace) for version control
- Checklist & escalations: manager_checklist_v1.md — Owner: Mina (implementation + compliance gating)

3) Sensitive roles handling
- We will enforce a 2-week embargo for teams flagged in the attached registry; Vivek will publish the list to People Ops by Fri (May 14).

4) Immediate actions (owners & deadlines)
- Mina: finalize manager_checklist_v1.md and confirm blackout list (May 14)
- Emily: draft 30-min manager training + one-pager cheat sheet (May 21)
- Jordan: confirm pilot participants and notify managers for scheduling (May 12) — status: in flight
- Grace: finalize drive folder and send versioned announcement to managers (May 17)

Attachments: manager_checklist_v1.md, 2027_review_form_v2.docx, manager_script_staggered.md, pilot_cohort_list.xlsx
